sentences.text: This review covers wellbore 15/9-F-12 on the Volve field, with daily reports from 2007-06-14 to 2016-10-20.
The report span is 3417.0 days, with 164 active days across 165 reports, of which 1 report is flagged; the wellbore has 7 campaigns.
Total depth is 3520.0 m measured depth (Sodir total depth) and 3106.6 m true vertical depth, the deepest values reported on the 2007-08-25 report.
Total activity time is 3764.5 h, of which primary lost time is 195.75 h, or 5.2 % of the activity time; possible lost time of 525.17 h (13.95 %) is kept separate below.

The well was completed in drilling terms on 2007-08-27 according to Sodir, was later worked over in campaigns running from 2009-03-13 to 2009-03-17, from 2010-09-20 to 2010-09-23 and from 2014-11-22 to 2014-11-27, and was plugged and abandoned in the campaigns from 2016-08-14 to 2016-08-28 and from 2016-10-19 to 2016-10-20; Sodir lists its status as P&A.

The main outcome was a drilled well to 3520.0 m MD with a P&A end state; the largest single loss items were drilling wait time and tubing-hanger and downhole safety valve repairs in the 2016 abandonment.
Campaign 1 ran from 2007-06-14 to 2007-10-11, a span of 120.0 days with 94 active days, dominant operation phase drilling.
Campaign 2 ran from 2007-12-30 to 2008-02-11, a span of 44.0 days with 38 active days, dominant operation phase drilling.
Campaign 3 ran from 2009-03-13 to 2009-03-17, a span of 5.0 days with 5 active days, dominant operation phase workover.
Campaign 4 ran from 2010-09-20 to 2010-09-23, a span of 4.0 days with 4 active days, dominant operation phase workover.
Campaign 5 ran from 2014-11-22 to 2014-11-27, a span of 6.0 days with 6 active days, dominant operation phase workover.
Campaign 6 ran from 2016-08-14 to 2016-08-28, a span of 15.0 days with 15 active days, dominant operation phase plug abandon.
Campaign 7 ran from 2016-10-19 to 2016-10-20, a span of 2.0 days with 2 active days, dominant operation phase plug abandon.

Sodir's completion date of 2007-08-27 is the end of drilling; the 2008 perforation and completion work, the 2009, 2010 and 2014 workovers and the 2016 abandonment all fall after it, which explains why the last report is dated 2016-10-20.
Section 0 holds moving activity before the first stated section, starting on 2007-06-13, with no hole size reported.

Section 1 was drilled at 36.0 in from 2007-06-14 to 2007-06-16, from 145.2 m to 258.0 m MD with 258.0 m TVD at section end, drilling 258.0 m of new hole at an average of 12.0 m/h while coded drilling.

Section 2 was drilled at 8.5 in from 2007-06-17 to 2007-07-04, from 258.0 m to 1353.0 m MD (TVD 1353.0 m), with 1095.0 m of new hole at an average of 9.38 m/h while coded drilling, over 432.0 h of activity.

Section 3 was drilled at 26.0 in from 2007-07-05 to 2007-07-14, from 258.0 m to 1369.0 m MD (TVD 1344.0 m); it added only 16.0 m of new hole at an average of 0.13 m/h while coded drilling, which took 125.25 h of drill-coded time.

Section 4 was drilled at 26.0 in from 2007-07-15 to 2007-07-20 between 1369.0 m and 1369.0 m MD, drilled no new hole, so no drilling rate is given, over 144.0 h of activity; the section-end TVD recorded for it is implausible and is not used.

Section 5 was drilled at 17.5 in from 2007-07-21 to 2007-08-10, from 1372.0 m to 2572.5 m MD (TVD 2481.5 m), with 1203.5 m of new hole at an average of 6.12 m/h while coded drilling, over 504.0 h of activity.

Section 6 was drilled at 12.25 in from 2007-08-11 to 2007-08-21, from 2576.0 m to 3114.0 m MD (TVD 2864.0 m), with 541.5 m of new hole at an average of 4.32 m/h while coded drilling, over 264.0 h of activity.

Section 7 was drilled at 8.5 in from 2007-08-22 to 2007-08-25, from 3116.0 m to 3520.0 m MD (TVD 3106.6 m), with 406.0 m of new hole at an average of 7.48 m/h while coded drilling, over 96.0 h of activity.
Sections 8 to 24 have no reported hole size (hole size unknown) and drilled no new hole; they cover testing, completion, workover and plug-and-abandonment work at 3520.0 m MD.
Section 8 started on 2007-08-26, and section 24 (the plug-and-abandonment section, 356.5 h of activity) ended on 2016-10-20.
Section 15 (no hole size reported) ran from 2008-01-03 to 2008-01-15 and took 312.0 h of activity, the largest of sections 8 to 24 apart from section 24.
Section 1 started below a casing shoe at 251.0 m; no casing set during section 1 is reported.
Section 2 started below the same casing shoe at 251.0 m and set no casing that is reported.
Section 3 started below the 251.0 m shoe and set casing with its shoe at 1357.0 m MD.
Section 4 started below the 1357.0 m shoe and set no casing.
Section 5 started below the 1357.0 m shoe and set no casing.
Section 6 started below the 1357.0 m shoe and set casing with its shoe at 3113.0 m MD.
Section 7 started below the 3113.0 m shoe and set no casing.
Sections 9 and 24 both started below a recorded shoe at 3519.0 m, and no casing set is reported for either.
Primary lost time totals 195.75 h, which is 5.2 % of the wellbore's 3764.5 h of activity time.
By section, primary lost time was 77.25 h in section 2, which is 17.88 % of that section's 432.0 h of activity.
Section 3 had 8.75 h of primary lost time (3.65 % of its activity), section 4 had 2.25 h (1.56 %) and section 5 had 2.75 h (0.55 %).
Section 6 had 13.25 h of primary lost time (5.02 % of its activity), section 7 had 1.5 h (1.56 %) and section 12 had 12.5 h (8.88 %).
Section 16 had 13.75 h of primary lost time (7.16 % of its activity), including the well-control interruption, and section 18 had 15.75 h (16.41 %).

Section 24 had 25.75 h of primary lost time (7.22 % of its 356.5 h of activity), the largest primary figure after section 2; sections 10, 13, 15, 17, 19 and 23 had primary lost time of 0.5 h, 1.0 h, 1.5 h, 9.5 h, 1.0 h and 8.75 h respectively.
Primary lost time by cause is 72.0 h of drilling wait, 59.25 h of repair, 58.0 h of waiting on weather, 2.25 h of rig up/down, 2.25 h of well control and 2.0 h of fish.

Possible lost time is reported separately and is not included in the primary figures: 525.17 h in total (13.95 % of activity), of which 449.17 h is coded interruption -- other, 30.25 h interruption -- wait, 25.25 h interruption -- maintain and 20.5 h workover -- wait.

By section, possible lost time was largest in section 15 at 186.25 h (59.7 % of its activity), then section 5 at 87.5 h (17.36 %) and section 2 at 71.0 h (16.44 %); section 1 had 3.0 h (4.17 %) of possible time and section 12 had 30.25 h (21.49 %).
On 2007-07-05 to 2007-07-14, the 26.0 in section 3 drilled only 16.0 m of new hole in 125.25 h of drill-coded time, the lowest rate of the well.
On 2008-01-15 a pressure test of the 9 5/8 in RTTS packer tie-back showed a leak from the B-annulus, which the operator then bled down to measure, and the rig ran a 3.5 h leak-off test on 2008-01-15.
On 2008-01-16 the rig waited 9.5 h for instructions from the office after the RTTS test, with routine BOP and valve tests done in the meantime.
On 2008-01-17 the perforation guns that had been run were pulled back out of the hole after the plan changed, which was coded as 10.5 h of possible lost time.
On 2008-01-18 the rig waited 16.0 h for a plan of action from the office, coded as possible lost time.
On 2008-01-19 the rig waited 6.0 h on high winds, and a well-control interruption of 2.25 h was coded that day when the aft pipe racker drag chain was found damaged.
On 2008-01-23 an electrical fault and locked brakes on the aft pipe racker held up operations for 5.75 h of possible lost time.
On 2016-08-15 the logging winch overheated during the plug run, costing 1.0 h of possible lost time.
On 2016-08-17 the downhole safety valve would not equalise and open, and the tubing-hanger and landing-string repairs that followed were coded as 12.0 h of primary lost time over 17 activities.

On 2016-08-18 the tubing hanger was pulled free with an overpull and the seals came out of the PBR, after which the tubing was pulled and the logging run took place; the radioactivity in the tubing led to a safety time-out that day.
On 2016-08-19 gas returns rose while circulating above the cement plug, and the crew lined the returns through gas traps before continuing.
On 2016-08-19 a loose stand was found in the derrick and the elevators were found damaged and changed out, a fish-coded interruption of 2.0 h of primary lost time.

sentences.text: On 2016-08-20 the connection backed out of an X-over at the tie-back, leaving the cutter-related BHA in the hole; a spear run and a cut of the surface tie-back followed on the same day, and these events are not coded as lost time.
Next well: plan the 26.0 in interval with a bit and BHA choice that avoids repeated low-rate drilling, since section 3 gave 0.13 m/h over 125.25 h of drill-coded time for 16.0 m of new hole.
Next well: test the tie-back and packer arrangement to pressure before running the completion, because the B-annulus leak on 2008-01-15 was followed by 9.5 h of waiting on 2008-01-16.

Next well: plan weather windows and crane-safe work for the wellhead area, since waiting on weather was 58.0 h of primary lost time and 186.25 h of possible time in section 15 was largely waiting on weather or other.
Next well: verify the downhole safety valve and tubing-hanger function before pulling completion equipment, because the 2016-08-17 valve failure led to 12.0 h of primary repair time.
Next well: check tong settings and torque limits before make-up, because an over-torqued connection due to a wrong tong setting on 2016-08-17 had to be broken out and inspected.
Next well: inspect elevators and check stands in the derrick before tripping, following the 2016-08-19 fish of 2.0 h of primary lost time caused by a loose stand and damaged elevators.

Next well: record hole size for every section, since sections 8 to 24 carry no reported hole size and so their drilling rates and lost-time shares cannot be compared with the 36.0 in to 8.5 in sections above.

row.comments:
Lined up to pump from cement unit down kill line on BOP. Closed pipe ram, verified line up. Pressured up to 170 bar in stepwise manner :
30 bar / 10 min - ok. Cumulative pumped 145 liter
100 bar / 5 min - ok. Cumulative pumped 400 liter
171,5 bar. Cumulative pumped 712 liter - dropped 3 bar / 5 min. Leakage rate 2 l/min. Onset of leak from B-annulus could be observed at 165 bar.

Allowed pressure to bleed off in attempt to establish leakage free pressure :

160 bar - dropped 5,1 bar / 10 min (3,2%)  - leakage 1,5 l/min
150 bar - dropped 4,6 bar / 10 min (3,1%) - leakage 1,5 l/min
140 bar - dropped 3,6 bar / 10 min (2,5%) - leakage 1,1 l/min
130 bar - dropped 3,2 bar / 10 min (2,5%) - leakage 1,0 l/min
120 bar - dropped 2,4 bar / 10 min (2,0%) - leakage 0,8 l/min
110 bar - dropped 2,4 bar / 10 min (2,2%) - leakage 0,7 l/min
100 bar - dropped 2,6 bar / 10 min (2,6%) - leakage 0,9 l/min
90 bar - dropped 1,7 bar / 10 min (1,9%) - leakage 0,5 l/min
80 bar - dropped 1,9 bar / 10 min (2,4%) - leakage 0,7 l/min
70 bar - dropped 1,5 bar / 10 min (2,2%) - leakage 0,5 l/min

Bled pressure in well to zero.

Waited for instuctions from town.

Meanwhile :
-Pressure tested safety valves
-Performed manitenance on rotary table lock
-Performed general housekeeping and PM's on drillfloor
-Removed BOP carrier from BOP
POOH with 4 1/2" Orient exact perforation gun assy on 5" DP from 862 m to 300 m MD according to tally.
Held tool box meeting and changed to 3 1/2" handling equipment.
POOH with 4 1/2" Orient exact perforation gun assy on 3 1/2" DP from 300 m to 217 m MD according to tally.
Held tool box talk prior to handling guns on rig floor. POOH with 4 1/2" Orient exact perforation gun assy from 217 m to OOH.
Flushed lines and pressure tested from pump room to lower kill on BOP 35/240 bar for 5 min.

Waited for plan of action from town. 

Meanwhile :
-Performed 6 month maintenance on TDS
-Installed centralizer ring on F-7
-Transfered 7 m3 packer fluid from pit 3 to cmt unit with MP2
-Installed back up BX elevator and function tested same
-Disconnected winch on aft TDS working platform
Waited on weather due to high winds up to 72 knop and danger for people to be present in well head module.

Waited on weather due to high winds up to 60 knop and danger for people to be present in well head module.

Meanwhile inspected AFT PRS and found damage on drag chain. Barried off rig floor.
Had VFD-fault (electrical problem) on AFT PRS racking arm.

The upper racking arm on the AFT PRS could not move because brakes were locked.

Meanwhile installed TIW on string and function tested BOP at low pressure.
Trouble shoot winch after not able to achieve stable running speed with winch. Suspected overheating of hydraulic system

Overtorqued connection between THRT and first joint due to wrong tong setting. 
Troubleshoot, broke out and inspected treads. Damaged. L/D damaged pup joint and THRT
Broke off 2x pup joints from first landing string joint
P/U backup THRT and first landing string joint
L/D back up THRT due to it not being able to communicate with DHSV

Prepared to P/U primary landing string. 
Meanwhile perform maintenance on BOP control system

P/U primary THRT, broke off damaged pup joint and L/D same. 
Replaced with new pup joint and M/U to THRT
P/U primary landing string
Lined up to line test. Go to low pressure 20bar. Cement pump tripped. Troubleshoot. Meanwhile lift remaining tubing handling equipment to rig floor. Reel and compact spider slips

Pressured up well to equalize and open DHSV, applied 130 bar to string, observed DHSV equalizing and opening at 122bar. Pressured up control lines to 520 bar. Bled off tubing pressure to zero via choke to trip tank. Returns 60 liters indicating that DHSV closed after pressure above is pled off. 
Repeated equalizing and bleeding off sequence and observed same volume bled off
Confirmed 520 bar on control line and applied 140 bar to the well, 170 liters pumped and 90 liters returned. Meanwhile evaluated situation. Discussed situation w/ onshore organisation.
Applied 100 bar to tubing. Disconnected cement hose and bled off directly into a drum. 51 liters returned indicating that DHSV was closed
Reconnected cement hose to tubing. Meanwhile held TBT to swap hydraulic pump to pressure up control line for DHSV

Connected another hydraulic pump to control line, applied 520bar to control line. Started pressuring up tubing while monitoring gauge on the hydraulic pump for indications of DHSV sleeve movement. 
Observed DHSV equalized and opened at 146 bar and stop pressuring up at 152bar. No indication of DHSV sleeve movement. Bled off pressure, volume returned 60 liters. 152bar trapped below DHSV

Evaluated situation. Discussed situation w/ onshore organisation, callled well integrity duty
Meanwhile prepared papers and serviced/drops checked rig floor equipment

Performed time out for safety w/ crew due to radioactivity recorded in 7in tubing. 
10-16 Bq/cm2 and 1-2uSv/h  recorded

Continued discussing way forward. Discussed risks, barrier status, well control contingencies. Agreed to attempt to pull tubing hanger with 152bar trapped pressure below DHSV. Updated change log. 
Meanwhile applied 20 bar to tubing and inflow tested DHSV, Good. Continued with rig maintenance and pressure tested valves S1 and C26, good
Performed Pre-job Meeting for pulling tubing hanger as per agreed new plan
R/D cementing hose, chiksans. Attempted to back off weco1502 swedge. Collar backing off together with swedge. Torqued up collar to 15000 ft*lbs and manage to break off swedge, L/D same

Installed circulating swedge for TDS. M/U TDS and unlock tubing hanger. 
Pull tubing hanger free with 185t hook load (15ton overpull). Observed drop in Trip tank indicating that A-annulus was not 100% full. Waited for trip tank level to stabilize, total of 2 m3 lost

Observed loose stand in derrick. Held TBT, recovered stand using forward PRS and returned to TDS. Held stand w/ aft PRS to lower down TDS to be able to inspect elevators. Elevators found to be damaged. Changed out elevators to spare set. 
Performed drops check of aft PRS before continuing with operation.
M/U TDS and staged up pump rate to 3700 l/min - 178 bar. Observed increase in gas returns to 10%, stopped pump and lined up returns through gas traps
POOH from 141,5m, visually checked all connections. When reached end of last 5,5in HWDP stand observed no BHA. The connection backed out from X-over
